description: This file defines the PromptSecurityGuardrail class which extends CustomGuardrail to provide file sanitization, message processing, and prompt security functionalities within a larger application. It includes methods for sanitizing file content, processing message files, and acting as a hook for prompt security checks, notably integrating with external APIs to perform content validation and modification.
